info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Rhyolite Notebook Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Rhyolite Notebook Detail Management API enables users to create detailed specifications for Rhyolite notebooks in the catalog. This endpoint facilitates the generation of comprehensive product information including features, pricing, and availability. Typically utilized by product managers and inventory teams, the API streamlines the process of adding new notebook details to the catalog, ensuring that customers have access to accurate and up-to-date product information. Developers can integrate this API to enhance catalog management and improve user experience.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create new details for a Rhyolite Notebook. Provide the necessary parameters in the request body to successfully add the details.
